definitions.gloss: membership fee, enrollment fee, registration fee
definitions.explanation: A one-time fee paid when joining an organization, gym, club, or service. Distinguished from recurring monthly or annual fees.

examples.japanese: このジムは{入会金|にゅうかいきん}が{無料|むりょう}キャンペーン{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: This gym currently has a free enrollment fee campaign.

examples.japanese: {入会金|にゅうかいきん}は{一度|いちど}だけお{支払|しはら}いいただきます。
examples.english: The membership fee is a one-time payment.

examples.japanese: {入会金|にゅうかいきん}{五千円|ごせんえん}と{月会費|げっかいひ}{三千円|さんぜんえん}がかかります。
examples.english: There's a 5,000 yen enrollment fee and a 3,000 yen monthly fee.

notes:
COMPOSITION:
・{入会|にゅうかい} (joining, enrollment) + {金|きん} (fee, money)

CONTRAST WITH OTHER FEES:
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん}: one-time enrollment fee
・{月会費|げっかいひ}: monthly membership fee
・{年会費|ねんかいひ}: annual membership fee
・{登録料|とうろくりょう}: registration fee

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん}{無料|むりょう} (free enrollment fee)
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん}を{払|はら}う (to pay enrollment fee)
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん}{免除|めんじょ} (waiver of enrollment fee)
・{入会金|にゅうかいきん}キャンペーン (enrollment fee campaign)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・スポーツジム (fitness gyms)
・{習|なら}い{事|ごと} (lessons, classes)
・クレジットカード (credit cards)
・{会員制|かいいんせい}サービス (membership services)
